limitations: This is an experiment built from captured UI data, not a verified pixel-identical live-store screenshot

Single-column poster is configured with one captured image cell; other module root heights come from the registry
Share glyph is a frozen approximation; multiline notice expansion control is omitted for this fully visible five-line fixture
Titles/prices/layout order are sample content; original shop name and historical counts are preserved
Some photographs repeat and A6 product-image side padding is preserved
